title: Meet Tiny Tim the Turtle
author: Shellfie original
credit: An original story written for Shellfie.

pages: Tim is a box turtle. He lives in the woods.
Tim has a hard shell. It is his house!
When a fox comes by, Tim hides. He shuts his shell like a box. Snap!
Tim eats worms, bugs, and berries. Yum!
One day, Tim found a big red strawberry.
He ate and ate. Now his face is red too!
A raccoon looked at Tim. "Is that a red rock?"
Tim likes to be alone. On hot days, he naps in cool mud.
In winter, Tim digs a hole. He sleeps until spring.
Box turtles can live more than fifty years. That is a lot of strawberries!
